mapper.select: SELECT "user_id" , "last_name" , "first_name" , "retirement_flag" , "retirement_date" , "email" , "password" , "password_changed_flag" , "account_division" , "business_corp_id" , "operating_company_id" , "perm_role_id" , to_char("two_factor_auth_datetime", 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "two_factor_auth_datetime" FROM "users" WHERE "del_flag" = 0 AND "retirement_flag" = 0 AND "email" = #{email}

SELECT CASE WHEN "account_lock_at" IS NOT NULL AND ( "account_lock_at"::timestamp + ( SELECT "code_value"::integer FROM "code_master" WHERE "del_flag" = 0 AND "main_code" = '001' AND "sub_code" = '0002' ) * INTERVAL '1 minute' ) > NOW()::timestamp THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END FROM "users" WHERE "del_flag" = 0 AND "user_id" = #{userId}

SELECT "user_id" ,"email" ,"last_name" ,"first_name" ,"password_changed_flag" ,"account_division" ,"business_corp_id" ,"operating_company_id" ,"perm_role_id" ,"retirement_flag" ,"retirement_date" ,to_char("account_lock_at", 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "account_lock_at" ,CASE WHEN "account_lock_at" IS NOT NULL AND ("account_lock_at"::timestamp + ( (SELECT "code_value" FROM "code_master" WHERE "del_flag" = 0 AND "main_code" = '001' AND "sub_code" = '0002') * INTERVAL '1 minute' )) > NOW()::timestamp THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "lock_flag" FROM "users" WHERE "del_flag" = 0 AND "user_id" = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE "users" SET "auth_failure_count" = "auth_failure_count" + 1 ,"account_lock_at" = CASE WHEN ("auth_failure_count" + 1) >= ( SELECT "code_value"::int FROM "code_master" WHERE "del_flag" = 0 AND "main_code" = '001' AND "sub_code" = '0001' ) THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE "account_lock_at" END WHERE "del_flag" = 0 AND "user_id" = #{userId}
UPDATE "users" SET "auth_failure_count" = 0 ,"last_login_at" = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, "account_lock_at" = NULL WHERE "del_flag" = 0 AND "retirement_flag" = 0 AND "user_id" = #{userId}
